needs.JIRA_BASE_URL: your Atlassian site origin, such as https://example.atlassian.net — the host shown in the browser address bar while you are signed in to Jira, with no path
needs.JIRA_EMAIL: the email address of the Atlassian account the API token belongs to; Jira rejects the token without the matching address
needs.JIRA_API_TOKEN: an Atlassian API token from id.atlassian.com, under Security > Create and manage API tokens > Create API token
